scientific_status: structural model comparison for a preliminary result; not production adoption and not an HTA baseline

prior_focused_run.note: Read-only provenance. The prior frozen plan and design rebuild the backbone and candidate configurations; any change to these files refuses every stage.

models.M0: legacy diagnosis structure: the backbone configuration with no stage_structured_diagnosis block (existing era schedule and MSM multiplier, no symptom component)
models.M1: routine plus AIDS-symptom cause-specific hazards; routine_hazard_scale = 1; only the three MSM multiplier anchors and the AIDS symptom probability vary
models.M2: described in AIDS_DEFINITION_ADJUDICATION.md / IMPLEMENTATION_NOTE.md only; never built or simulated in this design

discovery.anchor_rule: identity (M0) plus every prior Stage-C mechanism tuple of the backbone that passed the primary contract on fresh seeds (clause c1)
discovery.geometry: L-infinity boxes in coordinates normalised to the authorized ranges, centred on the balanced candidate and clipped to [0, 1]; inner box = maximin Latin hypercube; outer ring = outer box minus inner box, greedy maximin selection from a seeded uniform pool, distances including every earlier point
discovery.shard_rule: shard k covers backbone index (k mod 2) and slice (k div 2) of 4; vectors of a backbone are assigned to slices round-robin in design order; the identity and anchors are in slice 0; a partial discovery may be frozen only from a completed prefix of shards 0..2j+1

confirmation.shard_rule: (tuple, seed) pairs sorted by tuple order then seed; pair i goes to shard i mod 2

smoke.note: optional user-run two-trajectory check of the real trajectory path, written to a separate directory outside the provenance chain

time.clock: measure of the union of wall-clock intervals of every simulation-dispatching invocation (benchmark, discovery shards, confirmation shards); review pauses between invocations do not count; concurrent shards are not double counted
time.reserve_rule: before and during a discovery shard, new work stops when the remaining dispatch time would fall below the estimated confirmation time (360 trajectories at the measured benchmark seconds per trajectory, x1.10); confirmation is never pre-empted by discovery

target_contract.source: the 13-target forecast-window contract frozen 2026-09-21 (coupled_calibration_search.load_frozen_targets with the pinned register and wave plan); unchanged

historical_cross_validation.role: visible cross-validation only; never in I_max
